ctx.x: Shepard was a trombone player. Molly was a trombone player. Buddy Alphonse played alto. Who else? Who else? Who else played alto? I didn't know where she had. Did you have a clarinet? At that time, no, sir. Didn't have no clarinet. You know what I'm talking about?
No. We didn't have no clarinet in the, in the, in the, what you call it, but we had a clarinet in the tundra band.
